cases.name: alarm-delayed-violation
cases.yaml:
- id: motion-on
  triggers:
    - trigger: state
      entity_id: binary_sensor.motion
      to: "on"
  actions:
    - action: light.turn_on
      target:
        entity_id: light.hall
- id: delayed-off
  mode: restart
  triggers:
    - trigger: state
      entity_id: binary_sensor.motion
      to: "off"
  actions:
    - delay: 3
    - action: light.turn_off
      target:
        entity_id: light.hall
- id: alarm-on
  triggers:
    - trigger: state
      entity_id: input_boolean.alarm
      to: "on"
  actions:
    - action: light.turn_on
      target:
        entity_id: light.hall
